task_completed.description: True only if every acceptance criterion in the brief is met.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what was changed and why.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths of every file created, modified or deleted.

tests_executed.description: Every test or check command actually run. Do not list commands that were not run.

details.description: Counts or the first failing assertion; empty if none.

outstanding_problems.description: Anything unfinished, uncertain or blocked. Empty if none.
